groupUrls.title: LinkedIn group URLs
groupUrls.description: List of LinkedIn group URLs to crawl.

maxItems.title: Max posts per group
maxItems.description: Maximum number of post items to collect from each group.

mode.title: Crawl mode
mode.description: Crawl strategy: 'api' = fast HTTP API pagination (no browser), 'auth' = Playwright browser with login, 'public' = unauthenticated Playwright, 'auto' = smart fallback.

apiMode.title: Use API pagination mode
apiMode.description: When enabled, uses LinkedIn's internal API with paginationToken instead of browser scrolling. Much faster (~35-39 posts/request, no browser). Requires valid session cookies.

iterations.title: Pagination iterations
iterations.description: Number of API pages to fetch per group (API mode only). Each page returns ~35-39 posts. 6 iterations = ~200 posts.

pageDelayMinMs.title: Min delay between pages (ms)
pageDelayMinMs.description: Minimum wait between API page requests in milliseconds.

pageDelayMaxMs.title: Max delay between pages (ms)
pageDelayMaxMs.description: Maximum wait between API page requests in milliseconds.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per page
maxRetries.description: Retry count for a failed API page before giving up.

maxConsecutiveFailedPages.title: Max consecutive failed pages
maxConsecutiveFailedPages.description: Stop a group crawl if this many pages fail consecutively.

fetchTimeoutMs.title: Fetch timeout (ms)
fetchTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout per API request in milliseconds.

targetDate.title: Target date
targetDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date. Backend applies final filtering.

scrollTimes.title: Scroll times (browser mode only)
scrollTimes.description: Maximum scroll actions per group page (browser mode only).

delayMinMs.title: Min delay between scrolls (browser mode)
delayMinMs.description: Minimum wait after each scroll in milliseconds (browser mode only).

delayMaxMs.title: Max delay between scrolls (browser mode)
delayMaxMs.description: Maximum wait after each scroll in milliseconds (browser mode only).

sessionCookie.title: LinkedIn li_at cookie
sessionCookie.description: Optional LinkedIn li_at session cookie value.

storageStateJson.title: Playwright storage state JSON
storageStateJson.description: Playwright storage state JSON (cookies + localStorage). Strongly recommended — include JSESSIONID for proper CSRF token in API mode.
